scope: All 187 currently AP-bound chest identities. Normal-route annotations include inherited shrine-approach requirements. Does not include unbound or excluded catalog actors.
route_semantics: These are supported normal-route requirements, not a proof that no alternative exists. Region/story/goal rules remain additional dependencies. Vanilla combat equipment, cooking and climbing recovery are available.

routes.route: Climb the stone tower north of the river waterfall.
Enter the broken northwestern perimeter buttress from its opening.

routes.route: Enter the waterfall cave from the river bank; open the eastern-wall chest.
